title: Quadratic bounds for uncompletable words and matrix mortality
summary: Every finite nonempty incomplete uniquely decipherable code with maximum word length $k$ has an uncompletable word of length at most $4k^2-3k$. The bound is independent of the number of codewords and their total length. Deleting a complete codeword cycle gives a finite path-counting identity; Kraft equality then supplies a short word of deficient compressed mass. Cyclic averaging and padding turn it into an uncompletable word. Conditional expectation makes the construction polynomial-time and also decides completeness.
